name: Cloud Security
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)

beginner.summary: For cloud engineers, administrators and security staff starting cloud security. Covers the shared responsibility model, cloud identity, network security, data protection and encryption, logging and monitoring, posture checks, compute and serverless security, secrets, compliance basics and incident response in AWS and Azure, ending with securing a small cloud workload.
prerequisites: Has used AWS or Azure for basic tasks such as creating a VM or storage
Understands networking basics: IP addresses, ports and firewalls
Access to an AWS and an Azure free or training account
outcomes: Explain cloud security responsibilities and common cloud risks
Secure identities, networks, storage and compute in AWS and Azure
Turn on logging, threat detection and posture checks
Respond to a basic cloud security incident

days.topic: Cloud Security Overview and the Shared Responsibility Model
subtopics: Shared responsibility in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
Common cloud breaches and their causes
Cloud security frameworks: CSA CCM and CIS Benchmarks
Budgets and alerts to avoid surprise bills
days.lab_task: Set up AWS and Azure training accounts with budget alerts and MFA on the root and global admin accounts, and map five real cloud breaches to who was responsible for the failed control.
days.deliverable: Secured accounts and breach responsibility table
checks: Sign in to the root and global admin accounts
Responsible party and failed control named

days.topic: Cloud Identity: Users, Groups and Roles
subtopics: IAM users and Entra ID users
Access keys and why to avoid them
days.lab_task: Create users, groups and roles in AWS and Azure for developers, auditors and administrators with least privilege, and show each role can only do its job.
days.deliverable: Identity set-up and permission test results
checks: Delete a resource as an auditor
Deploy a VM as a developer in the allowed resource group

days.topic: IAM Policies in Practice
subtopics: AWS policy structure: effect, action, resource, condition
days.lab_task: Write a custom AWS policy that allows S3 access only to one bucket with MFA, a custom Azure role for VM operators, and test both with simulators and real calls.
days.deliverable: Custom policies and test results
checks: No unintended public or cross-account access

days.topic: Network Security in the Cloud
subtopics: Security groups and network security groups
days.lab_task: Build a two-tier network in AWS and Azure with public and private subnets, restrict access with security groups, reach a private VM through a bastion and inspect flow logs for denied traffic.
days.deliverable: Network diagrams, rules and flow log evidence
checks: Reach the database VM from the internet
Session opened without a public IP on the VM
Find denied traffic in flow logs
objectives: Use security groups and private subnets

days.topic: Data Protection: Storage Security and Encryption
subtopics: Securing S3 buckets and Azure Storage
Encryption at rest with managed keys
Customer-managed keys in KMS and Key Vault
days.lab_task: Secure a bucket and a storage account with public access blocked, customer-managed key encryption, versioning and access logs, then recover a deleted object.
days.deliverable: Storage configuration and recovery evidence
checks: Data cannot be read until the key is enabled
Restored from versioning or soft delete

days.topic: Key and Secrets Management
subtopics: Secrets Manager and Key Vault secrets
days.lab_task: Store a database password in Secrets Manager and Key Vault, let a VM read it with its own identity, rotate it and audit who accessed it.
days.deliverable: Secrets set-up, rotation record and audit log
checks: Read the secret from the VM
Retrieved with the VM identity, no stored credentials
Reads recorded with identity and time

days.topic: Logging and Monitoring in the Cloud
subtopics: Azure Activity Log and diagnostic settings
days.lab_task: Enable organisation-wide audit logging in AWS and Azure, centralise logs, and alert when someone disables logging or creates an access key.
days.deliverable: Logging configuration and alert evidence
checks: Try to stop CloudTrail as a normal user
Results returned from the central store

days.topic: Threat Detection Services
subtopics: Google Security Command Center in brief
days.lab_task: Enable GuardDuty and Defender for Cloud, generate sample findings, route high-severity findings to email or chat and write first response steps for three finding types.
days.deliverable: Detection set-up, routed findings and response steps
checks: Clear first actions for each finding type

days.topic: Cloud Security Posture Checks
subtopics: CIS Benchmarks for AWS and Azure
AWS Security Hub and Config rules
days.lab_task: Scan the lab accounts with Prowler and Security Hub, fix the top ten findings, raise the Azure secure score and track the improvement.
days.deliverable: Scan results, fixes and posture trend

days.topic: Securing Virtual Machines and Compute
subtopics: Session Manager instead of SSH keys
days.lab_task: Launch VMs from a hardened image, require IMDSv2, patch them with Systems Manager, open admin access just in time and scan them with Inspector.
days.deliverable: Configuration evidence and scan results
checks: Query instance metadata without a token
Port opens only for the approved time
Vulnerabilities listed and critical ones patched

days.topic: Serverless and PaaS Security
days.lab_task: Secure a Lambda function and an Azure Function behind authenticated APIs with least-privilege roles, secrets from the vault and private database access.
days.deliverable: Secured functions and test results
checks: Call the API without a token
Try an action outside the function role
Reachable only from the private network

days.topic: Securing Managed Databases
subtopics: Managed database options: RDS, Azure SQL, Cloud SQL
Encryption at rest and in transit
days.lab_task: Deploy a managed database reachable only from a private subnet, require TLS and identity-based login, turn on auditing and restore it to a point in time.
days.deliverable: Database configuration, audit log and restore evidence
checks: Restore to a point in time
Database restored with data from that time

days.topic: Container Security in the Cloud Basics
days.lab_task: Scan images in a private registry, block deployment of images with critical vulnerabilities, create a private cluster and give a pod access to storage with a workload identity.
days.deliverable: Scan results, policy and cluster configuration
checks: Push an image with a critical vulnerability
Scan flags it and deployment is blocked
Reach the cluster API from the internet
Access through workload identity, no keys

days.topic: Web Application Firewalls and DDoS Protection
days.lab_task: Put a web app behind a WAF with managed rules and rate limiting, send SQL injection and flood test traffic and confirm it is blocked and logged.
days.deliverable: WAF configuration and test results

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code Security
days.lab_task: Scan provided Terraform code with Checkov, fix the misconfigurations, add the scan to a pull request workflow and protect the state file.
days.deliverable: Fixed code, scan results and workflow
checks: Open a pull request with a public bucket

days.topic: Compliance in the Cloud
subtopics: Compliance frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS
Data residency and India's DPDP Act
days.lab_task: Check a workload against a compliance standard with Azure Policy and AWS Config, collect evidence for five controls and download provider compliance reports.
days.deliverable: Compliance results, evidence pack and gap list
checks: Evidence for each of the five controls
Resource creation outside the allowed region is denied

days.topic: Incident Response in the Cloud
tools: Microsoft Sentinel or Defender for Cloud
days.lab_task: Respond to a simulated leaked access key: detect it, disable the key, find what it did in the logs, isolate an affected instance, snapshot it and write the report.
days.deliverable: Incident timeline and report
checks: All API calls with the key listed
Network access removed and snapshot taken

days.topic: Multi-Cloud and Google Cloud Security Basics
subtopics: Comparing AWS, Azure and Google Cloud controls
days.lab_task: Secure a Google Cloud project with least-privilege IAM, an organisation policy that blocks public IPs and Security Command Center, and compare the controls with AWS and Azure.
days.deliverable: Google Cloud configuration and comparison table
checks: Create a VM with a public IP
Equivalent controls named for three clouds

days.topic: AWS and Azure Security Certification Preparation
days.lab_task: Take timed practice exams for AWS Security Specialty and AZ-500, analyse results by domain and plan final study and labs.
days.deliverable: Practice scores, analysis and study plan

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Securing a Cloud Web Application
days.lab_task: Deploy a web application with a database in AWS or Azure using Terraform, secure identity, network, data and secrets, turn on logging, detection and posture checks, respond to a simulated key leak and present the security report.
days.deliverable: Terraform code, posture report, incident report and a 10-minute presentation
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one secured workload

intermediate.summary: For cloud and security engineers securing production workloads. Covers multi-account and landing zone security, advanced IAM and federation, network architecture and private connectivity, data security at scale, detection engineering for cloud logs, Kubernetes security, DevSecOps for cloud, CSPM and CNAPP tools, compliance automation and cloud incident response.
prerequisites: Can secure identity, network and storage in AWS or Azure
Knows cloud logging and threat detection services
outcomes: Design secure landing zones and organisation guardrails
Build cloud detections and automated responses
Automate compliance and lead cloud incident response

days.topic: Secure Landing Zones and Multi-Account Design
subtopics: Azure management groups and landing zones
Security, logging and shared services accounts
Guardrails with service control policies and Azure Policy
days.lab_task: Build a landing zone with separate security, logging and workload accounts or subscriptions, apply guardrails that block disabling logging and leaving approved regions, and test them.
days.deliverable: Landing zone design, guardrails and test results
checks: Disable CloudTrail in a workload account
Create a resource in an unapproved region

days.topic: Advanced IAM: Federation, SSO and Permission Management
subtopics: Federating with a corporate identity provider
AWS IAM Identity Center and Entra ID
days.lab_task: Federate AWS with Entra ID, use attribute-based access by team, set up just-in-time admin with PIM and remove unused permissions found by Access Analyzer.
days.deliverable: Federation set-up, ABAC policy, PIM configuration and permission clean-up
checks: Sign in to AWS through Entra ID
Granted for a limited time with approval
Policies reduced and apps still work

days.topic: Network Security Architecture and Private Connectivity
subtopics: Private connectivity: VPN and Direct Connect or ExpressRoute
days.lab_task: Build a hub-and-spoke network with a central firewall, force all egress through it with domain allow lists, connect a simulated on-premise site by VPN and inspect blocked traffic.
days.deliverable: Network design, firewall rules and inspection evidence
checks: Call an unapproved domain from a workload
Connection works on allowed ports only

days.topic: Data Security at Scale
subtopics: Data discovery with Macie and Purview
Database security: RDS and Azure SQL
days.lab_task: Discover personal data in storage with Macie or Purview, encrypt and restrict access, enable database auditing and set immutable backups that survive an admin deletion attempt.
days.deliverable: Discovery results, controls and backup test
checks: Delete a backup as an admin

days.topic: Cloud Detection Engineering
subtopics: Detection queries in KQL and Athena
Mapping to MITRE ATT&CK for cloud
Testing detections with Stratus Red Team
Detection for identity attacks in the cloud
days.lab_task: Write six cloud detections for credential misuse, persistence and data exfiltration, test them with Stratus Red Team and tune them.
days.deliverable: Detection rules, test results and tuning notes

days.topic: Automated Response and Security Orchestration
days.lab_task: Build automations that make public buckets private, quarantine a VM flagged by GuardDuty after approval and notify the team, and measure response time.
days.deliverable: Automations, test results and timing

days.topic: Kubernetes Security in Managed Clusters
subtopics: Admission control with Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper
days.lab_task: Harden a managed cluster with private API access, RBAC, Pod Security Standards, network policies and admission policies, and detect a container escape attempt with Falco.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, policies and detection evidence

days.topic: DevSecOps Pipelines for Cloud Workloads
subtopics: Deployment with OIDC instead of keys
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that scans code, dependencies, secrets, Terraform and images, signs images, deploys to the cloud with OIDC and blocks deployment on critical findings.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, scan reports and signed image
checks: No long-lived cloud keys in the pipeline

days.topic: CSPM and CNAPP Platforms
days.lab_task: Use a CNAPP platform to find the top three attack paths in the lab, fix them, send remaining findings to Jira with owners and report risk reduction.
days.deliverable: Attack path analysis, fixes and risk report
checks: Top three paths with entry and target

days.topic: Secrets, Certificates and Workload Identity at Scale
subtopics: Central secrets management with HashiCorp Vault
days.lab_task: Replace static database passwords with Vault dynamic credentials, use workload identity federation from Kubernetes to the cloud and detect a leaked secret in a repository.
days.deliverable: Vault configuration, identity set-up and leak detection evidence
checks: Access cloud storage from a pod

days.topic: Compliance Automation and Policy as Code
subtopics: Open Policy Agent for cloud resources
days.lab_task: Deploy a conformance pack and an Azure Policy initiative for a standard, write an OPA policy for Terraform plans, handle one waiver and produce an auditor report.
days.deliverable: Policies, waiver record and auditor report
checks: Evaluate a Terraform plan with OPA

days.topic: Cloud Incident Response and Forensics
days.lab_task: Investigate a simulated multi-step cloud compromise from leaked keys to data theft, acquire disk evidence, contain it and write a forensic report.
days.deliverable: Investigation timeline, evidence and forensic report
checks: Initial access to exfiltration in order
Disk snapshot and logs preserved with hashes

days.topic: Vulnerability Management for Cloud Workloads
subtopics: Golden images and rebuilds instead of patching
days.lab_task: Scan VMs, images and functions across the lab accounts, prioritise findings by internet exposure and known exploits, rebuild one image and report SLA status by owner.
days.deliverable: Scan results, prioritised list, rebuilt image and SLA report
checks: Exposed and exploited findings ranked first
Rescan shows the critical findings fixed

days.topic: Logging Architecture and SIEM Integration at Scale
subtopics: Sending cloud logs to Sentinel or Splunk
days.lab_task: Collect audit, network and workload logs from all lab accounts into a security data lake in OCSF format, forward key sources to a SIEM, set retention tiers and alert if a source stops sending.
days.deliverable: Logging architecture, pipeline configuration and source health alert
checks: Hot and archive tiers set with costs

days.topic: Securing Cloud APIs and Identity for Applications
subtopics: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect for cloud apps
Cognito and Entra ID External ID
days.lab_task: Protect an API with OAuth tokens from Cognito or Entra ID, scopes per operation, throttling and logging, and test it with valid, expired and wrongly scoped tokens.
days.deliverable: API configuration and test results
checks: Call a write operation with a read scope

days.topic: Security for Data and AI Services in the Cloud
subtopics: Lake Formation and Purview access controls
Securing Azure OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock
Content filtering and logging for AI
Prompt injection risks for cloud AI apps
days.lab_task: Restrict a data lake with column-level permissions, put an AI service behind a private endpoint with logging and content filters, and test a prompt injection against the app.
days.deliverable: Access controls, AI configuration and test results
checks: Call the AI service from the internet
Blocked or logged with the gap recorded

days.topic: Cost, Security and Governance Together
days.lab_task: Enforce owner and data classification tags, detect a crypto-mining spike from cost anomalies, remove unused exposed resources and report security cost by team.
days.deliverable: Tag policy, anomaly evidence and cost report

days.topic: Third-Party and SaaS Security
days.lab_task: Review OAuth app consents in Microsoft 365, restrict user consent, give a vendor limited cross-account access with an external ID and remove a vendor's access completely.
days.deliverable: Consent review, vendor access set-up and offboarding evidence
checks: Assume the vendor role without the external ID

days.topic: Authorised Cloud Security Testing and Red Teaming
subtopics: Rules for testing in the cloud
Cloud attack tools: Pacu and ROADtools
days.lab_task: Under written authorisation in the lab, find an IAM privilege escalation path with Pacu, test exposed services, report findings and retest after fixes.
days.deliverable: Authorisation, findings report and retest results
checks: Path from low-privilege user to admin shown
Evidence, risk and fix for each

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Secure Multi-Account Cloud Platform
tools: AWS Control Tower or Azure Landing Zones
days.lab_task: Build a secure platform with a landing zone, federated access, hub-and-spoke network, data protection, cloud detections with automated response, a DevSecOps pipeline and compliance reporting, then present it.
days.deliverable: Terraform repository, pipeline, detection rules, compliance report and a 15-minute demo
checks: Blocked in the pipeline or by guardrails
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For cloud security architects and leads. Covers cloud security architecture and zero trust, enterprise multi-cloud governance, advanced identity attacks and defences, cloud-native threat hunting, supply chain security, confidential computing, sovereign and regulated cloud, security for AI platforms, red and purple teaming in the cloud, security engineering at scale and cloud security leadership.
prerequisites: Has designed or run security for production cloud environments
Knows landing zones, detection, Kubernetes and DevSecOps in the cloud
outcomes: Architect zero trust and multi-cloud security
Hunt threats and run purple teams in the cloud
Secure supply chains, AI platforms and regulated workloads
Lead cloud security programmes and report to boards

days.topic: Cloud Security Architecture and Reference Designs
subtopics: Reference architectures from AWS, Azure and Google
days.lab_task: Design and threat-model a regulated payments platform on two clouds with blast-radius limits and security requirements, record decisions and defend them in a review.
days.deliverable: Architecture, threat model, requirements and decision records
checks: Threats and controls for every component
A compromise in one account cannot reach the others

days.topic: Zero Trust Architecture in the Cloud
days.lab_task: Replace VPN access to an internal app with identity-aware access that checks user, device and risk, add service identity between microservices and measure maturity.
days.deliverable: Access design, configuration and maturity assessment
checks: Call a service without a valid identity
objectives: Apply zero trust in the cloud

days.topic: Enterprise Multi-Cloud Security Governance
days.lab_task: Design a governance model for three clouds and 200 accounts with a common control set, consistent policies, an exception process and a metrics dashboard.
days.deliverable: Governance model, control set and dashboard
checks: Run an exception through the process
Approved with expiry and compensating control
Compliance and risk by cloud and business unit

days.topic: Advanced Cloud Identity Attacks and Defences
days.lab_task: In the lab, demonstrate token replay and consent phishing, detect both, harden the identity provider and rehearse recovery from a compromised global admin.
days.deliverable: Attack evidence, detections, hardening and recovery runbook
checks: Access restored and attacker sessions revoked

days.topic: Cloud Threat Hunting
subtopics: Using CloudTrail Lake and KQL at scale
days.lab_task: Run three hunts across a month of cloud and Kubernetes logs for hidden IAM persistence, unusual data access and suspicious cluster activity, and turn one into a detection.
days.deliverable: Hunt reports and new detection
checks: Unusual downloads found or ruled out with evidence

days.topic: Purple Teaming and Adversary Emulation in the Cloud
subtopics: Stratus Red Team and Atomic tests at scale
days.lab_task: Emulate a named cloud threat actor's techniques, score detection coverage, fix gaps with the blue team and schedule regression runs.
days.deliverable: Emulation plan, coverage scores and regression schedule
checks: Detected, logged and missed recorded per technique

days.topic: Software Supply Chain Security
days.lab_task: Raise a build pipeline to SLSA level 3 with provenance, sign images and SBOMs, and allow only signed images with valid provenance into the cluster.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, provenance, SBOMs and admission policy
checks: Find a vulnerable dependency in the SBOM

days.topic: Confidential Computing and Advanced Data Protection
subtopics: AWS Nitro Enclaves and Azure confidential VMs
Bring and hold your own key
days.lab_task: Process sensitive records inside a confidential environment with keys released only to it, compare with standard encryption and document the trade-offs.
days.deliverable: Confidential workload, key policy and trade-off note
checks: Key released only to the attested environment
objectives: Decide when it is worth it

days.topic: Sovereign Cloud and Regulated Workloads
subtopics: India's DPDP Act, RBI and SEBI cloud rules
Encryption and key custody for sovereignty
days.lab_task: Design a cloud deployment for an Indian bank that meets RBI outsourcing and data localisation rules, with residency guardrails, key custody and regulator documentation.
days.deliverable: Design, guardrails and regulator documentation
checks: Keys held by the bank as required
Each rule mapped to a control

days.topic: Security for AI and Machine Learning Platforms
subtopics: Prompt injection and data leakage in AI apps
days.lab_task: Secure an ML platform's data, training jobs and model registry, add guardrails to a generative AI app, red-team it and set up AI usage monitoring.
days.deliverable: Platform controls, guardrails, red-team report and monitoring
checks: Access training data from an unapproved role
Attacks blocked or recorded with fixes

days.topic: Security Engineering at Scale: Automation and Platforms
subtopics: Security as a platform for engineering teams
tools: Security data lake (Amazon Security Lake or Sentinel)
days.lab_task: Build a paved road with secure Terraform modules and a self-service template, centralise security findings in a security data lake and report adoption and risk metrics.
days.deliverable: Secure modules, template, data lake and metrics
checks: Create a service from the template
Secure by default with no findings
Findings from all accounts in one place
Share of teams using the paved road

days.topic: Kubernetes and Cloud-Native Security at Scale
days.lab_task: Apply consistent policies across three clusters, enforce mTLS with a service mesh, detect suspicious process activity with eBPF and respond to a compromised pod.
days.deliverable: Policies, mesh configuration, detections and response record
checks: Deploy a non-compliant workload to any cluster

days.topic: Resilience, Ransomware and Disaster Recovery in the Cloud
days.lab_task: Simulate ransomware encrypting a workload account, recover into a clean isolated account from immutable backups and measure recovery time and data loss.
days.deliverable: Recovery plan, test results and metrics
checks: Delete backups as a compromised admin
RTO and RPO compared with targets

days.topic: Cloud Security Operations Centre Design
subtopics: Metrics: MTTD and MTTR for cloud
days.lab_task: Design a cloud SOC with telemetry, detections, playbooks and automation, run a simulated week of alerts and report detection and response metrics.
days.deliverable: SOC design, playbooks and metrics report

days.topic: Cloud Security Risk Quantification and Board Reporting
days.lab_task: Quantify three cloud loss scenarios with FAIR, show the risk reduction of planned controls and present an investment case to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Risk model, investment case and board presentation
checks: Before and after values for each control

days.topic: Mergers, Acquisitions and Cloud Estate Integration
subtopics: Security due diligence for cloud estates
days.lab_task: Run security due diligence on an acquired company's cloud estate, find unknown and risky accounts, set safe cross-tenant access and plan bringing the estate under group guardrails.
days.deliverable: Due diligence report, access configuration and integration plan
checks: Only approved users and apps allowed

days.topic: Cloud Security Programme Leadership
subtopics: Working with platform and product teams
days.lab_task: Build a cloud security programme for a growing company with team structure, skills plan, tooling budget, roadmap and engagement model with engineering teams.
days.deliverable: Programme plan
checks: How teams get help and reviews defined

days.topic: CCSP and Advanced Cloud Security Certification Preparation
days.lab_task: Take a timed CCSP practice exam, analyse results by domain and plan final study.
days.deliverable: Practice score, analysis and study plan

days.topic: Troubleshooting Cloud Security Incidents at Scale
days.lab_task: Handle three injected incidents (a pipeline compromise, a guardrail blocking production deployments and a vendor breach), restore safe operation and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident records, fixes and runbooks
checks: Credentials rotated and malicious changes reverted
Deployments resume without weakening the control
Write a runbook for vendor breaches

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Cloud Security Strategy and Platform for an Enterprise
subtopics: Supply chain and AI platform security
days.lab_task: Deliver a cloud security strategy and working platform with zero trust access, multi-cloud guardrails, cloud detections proven by purple teaming, signed supply chain, AI platform controls and ransomware recovery, then present the risk case to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Strategy, platform code, test reports, risk model and a 20-minute board presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one strategy
Lead cloud security at board level
